card.title: Fingerprint Calibration After Screen Replacement
symptoms: fingerprint not working after screen replacement

claims.statement: Xiaomi phones with in-display fingerprint need FOD calibration after a screen replacement.
claims.evidence: Calibration via the CIT hidden menu with a three-piece rubber tool.

claims.statement: CIT is reached by tapping Kernel version 4 times in Settings > My Device > Detailed info and specs, then Additional Tools > FOD Fingerprint Calibration.
Calibration error 1517 means the textured pad is not aligned horizontally; 1503 means the sensor was not fully covered; 1531 (polar degree) is usually pressure, worn grooves or dirt.
claims.evidence: Error meanings collected by the author.

procedure: Open CIT and start FOD Fingerprint Calibration.
Use the plain white pad, then the black pad, then the textured white pad aligned with horizontal lines.
On failure restart the sequence; a thumb pressed vertically may pass the last step.
Restart the phone after Test Finished and enroll a fingerprint.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
